identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Othones has a broad oval face, a moderately high forehead, substantial cheekbones and a firm moderately broad jaw ending in a rounded-square chin. His fair to light warm skin has a ruddy cast across the cheeks and nose and fine native surface texture; tiny isolated freckles cannot be confirmed individually. His eyes are muted gray-green, deep-set and slightly hooded, with relatively narrow almond openings and a calm direct gaze. Dark medium-thick brows sit fairly close to the eyes and rise slightly toward their outer thirds, with rounded inner ends. His nose is medium-long and straight along the bridge, with a broad rounded projecting tip and moderately wide nostrils. His mouth is compact, with a thin cupid-shaped upper lip and a fuller lower lip, held neutrally. Dark facial hair forms a substantial moustache and short beard around the chin and jaw; cheek coverage is visibly uneven and sparser, with a small denser patch beneath the lower lip. His hair is very dark brown, short and close around the sides, with soft waves and a short uneven curled fringe swept across the upper forehead. There is no long mane or high styled crest. No definite scar or tattoo is visible. Preserve mild natural facial asymmetry and the relaxed expression, rather than interpreting rendered shadows as injuries.
